Non-admin users attempting to access `/dashboard` are automatically redirected to `/kasir`. - **Cashier POS Register (`/kasir`)**: Real-time line-item addition, cart quantity adjustments, automatic subtotal calculation, instant cash change computation, and printable HTML receipt generation. - **Inventory Stock & Barcode Engine (`/stock-barang`)**: Product SKU catalog tracking, purchase vs retail prices, dynamic SVG barcode generation powered by JsBarcode, dual-store location filtering (Store 1 & Store 2), and stock status alert pills. - **Financial Profit Margin Reports (`/finance`)**: Real-time gross profit calculation, volume count of sold items, customizable date range filtering (`tgldari` & `tglsampai`), and 1-click Excel report export. - **Accounts Payable Ledger (`/bill`)**: Vendor invoice tracking, due dates, payment status tags (*Lunas* / *Belum Dibayar* / *Belum Lunas*), and outstanding balance remainders. - **Atomic Sequence Generator**: Incremental sequence counter collection (`database_sequences`) utilizing MongoDB `findAndModify` operations for collision-free transactional invoice numbers. - **Database Seeder (`/seed`)**: Built-in HTTP endpoint to bootstrap demo administrator and cashier accounts, sample electronic products, and vendor billing records. --- ## Tech Stack | Category | Technology | Description / Purpose | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **Backend Framework** | Spring Boot `3.2.4` | Enterprise MVC application framework, inversion of control, and dependency injection | | **Programming Language** | Java `17` LTS | Object-oriented business logic, records, and service layer implementations | | **Database** | MongoDB `7.0` | NoSQL document database for product catalog, sales invoices, and atomic sequences | | **Data Access** | Spring Data MongoDB | Repository abstractions and custom aggregation queries | | **Template Engine** | Thymeleaf `3.x` | Server-side HTML template rendering with dynamic model binding | | **UI & Theme** | Soft UI Dashboard (Bootstrap 5) | Responsive dashboard interface with card layouts and data tables | | **Barcode Generator** | JsBarcode `3.11.5` | Client-side SVG barcode rendering per product identifier | | **Productivity** | Project Lombok | Eliminates boilerplate getters, setters, and constructors in domain models | | **Build System** | Apache Maven Wrapper (`./mvnw`) | Dependency management and executable JAR compilation | | **Containerization** | Docker | Container runtime for local MongoDB instance | ## Tutorial Run Local & Setup ### 1. Prerequisites - **Java Development Kit (JDK)**: Version `17` LTS (OpenJDK or Oracle JDK) - **Docker**: For running a local MongoDB instance - **Apache Maven**: Provided via the bundled Maven Wrapper (`./mvnw`) ### 2. Configuration & Environment Database connection settings are configured in `src/main/resources/application.properties`: ```properties spring.application.name=Simpos spring.data.mongodb.host=localhost spring.data.mongodb.port=27017 spring.data.mongodb.database=simpos server.port=8081 ``` ### 3. Database Architecture & Local MongoDB Simpos structures data across 6 primary MongoDB document collections (`com.primaelectronic.pos.model`): ```json // 1. user — User accounts and store assignment { "_id": 1, "username": "hamam", "password": "123", "access": 1, // 1: Admin, 2: Cashier "store": 1 } // 2. stock — Product catalog and inventory { "_id": 1, "name": "Samsung Galaxy S23", "qty": 10, "priceInit": 12000000.0, // Purchase price "priceFinal": 13000000.0, // Retail selling price "store": 1, "pic": "admin", "createdAt": "2026-11-17T10:00:00", "modifiedAt": "2026-11-17T10:00:00", "modifiedBy": "admin" } // 3. transaction — Cashier checkout records { "_id": 1, "date": "2026-11-17T10:15:00", "amount": 1, "product": "Samsung Galaxy S23", "userId": "kasir", "toko": 1, "payment": "CASH" } // 4. invoice — Sales receipts with printable HTML { "_id": "6739...", "databarang": "[{\"name\":\"Samsung Galaxy S23\",\"qty\":1,\"price\":13000000}]", "nota": "...", "money": 13000000.0, "toko": 1, "tgl": "2026-11-17T10:15:00", "username": "kasir", "payment": "CASH" } // 5. bill — Accounts payable vendor invoices { "_id": 1, "nama": "Supplier Elektronik Jaya", "nominal": "50000000", "ket": "Pengadaan Stok Smartphone Batch 1", "pic": "Widi Firmansyah", "status": 1, // 1: Lunas, 2: Belum Dibayar, 3: Belum Lunas "nominalMinus": 0, "dueDate": "2026-12-01", "createdAt": "2026-11-17", "createdBy": "hamam" } // 6. database_sequences — Atomic auto-increment counters { "_id": "transaction_sequence", "seq": 1 } ``` Start a local MongoDB container via Docker: ```bash docker run -d --name simpos-mongo -p 27017:27017 mongo:7.0 ``` ### 4. Running the Spring Boot Application ```bash # Clone the repository git clone https://github.com/widifirmaan/springboot-simple-pos.git cd springboot-simple-pos # Run application using Maven Wrapper ./mvnw spring-boot:run ``` The server starts on port `8081`. Open [http://localhost:8081](http://localhost:8081) in your browser. ### 5. Seeding Demo Data & Auth Credentials Once the server is running, trigger database seeding via browser or curl: ```bash curl http://localhost:8081/seed ``` #### Pre-seeded Demo Accounts: - **Administrator**: Username `hamam` / Password `123` (Full access to all modules) - **Cashier**: Username `kasir` / Password `123` (Access to cashier terminal and bills) --- ## Author Made with ❤️ by **Widi Firmansyah** / [widifirmaan.web.id](https://widifirmaan.web.id)

![Admin Settings](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/widifirmaan/nextjs-velvetsnap-photobox/main/screenshots/Admin%20Settings%20Mobile.png) | --- ## Fitur - **Dual Kiosk Themes**: Modern clean interface (`/v1`) and vintage editorial newspaper aesthetic (`/v2`) powered by paper textures, custom typography mastheads, and responsive scaling. - **Guided Customer Workflow**: Step-by-step state machine guiding guests through Template Selection, DOKU SNAP QRIS Payment (with testing/operator bypass support), Viewfinder Capture, Photo Adjustment & Stickers, and Print/Download. - **Webcam Hardware Bridge (`react-webcam`)**: Camera stream integration with configurable countdown timers (3s, 5s), automated burst capture sequences, flash animation transitions, and slot indicators. - **Automated Video Clip Recorder (`useClipRecorder`)**: In-browser background video recording capturing behind-the-scenes video memories during photo shoots. - **Multi-Layer Canvas Compositor (`react-konva`)**: High-resolution 2D canvas engine handling photo frame masking, aspect-ratio scaling, drag-and-drop sticker overlays, and composite strip rendering. - **Client-Side Background Removal (WASM)**: Neural network background removal powered by `@imgly/background-removal` WebAssembly runtime executing directly in the browser without third-party servers. - **Interactive Template Studio (`/admin/template-studio`)**: Visual strip designer for kiosk operators featuring draggable canvas layers, sticker catalogs, and geometric coordinate controls. - **Kiosk Hardware Health Monitor (`/admin/devices`)**: Hardware diagnostic panel verifying webcam feed availability, resolution profiles, and kiosk connection states. - **Admin Analytics Dashboard (`/admin`)**: Operations portal tracking session volume, daily/weekly revenue graphs, customer transaction history, and pricing rules. - **Mobile Digital Delivery & Download Portal (`/download`)**: On-screen QR ticket generation via `qrcode` allowing users to scan and download full-resolution digital strips and behind-the-scenes video clips directly to mobile devices via `/download?id=`. --- ## Tech Stack | Category | Technology | Description / Purpose | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **Core Framework** | Next.js `16.2.6` (App Router), React `19.2.4` | App Router architecture, server components, and concurrent UI rendering | | **Canvas & Compositing** | Konva `10.3.0`, React-Konva `19.2.4` | 2D canvas drawing engine for photo strip layout composition and sticker layers | | **Camera & Video** | React-Webcam `7.2.0` | MediaDevices API abstraction for webcam streaming and camera capture | | **AI / Machine Learning** | `@imgly/background-removal` `1.7.0` | Client-side neural network running via WebAssembly to remove backgrounds | | **Database** | Cloudflare D1 (SQLite 3) | Relational database for settings, templates, device status, and transaction history | | **Media Storage** | Cloudinary API | Cloud storage for rendered photo strips, template graphics, and recorded video clips | | **API Server** | Serverless Edge Worker (`worker.js`) | Endpoint router handling `/api/*` data operations and DOKU SNAP QRIS payment workflows | | **Utilities & QR** | QRCode `1.5.4`, UUID `9.0.0`, Lucide React | QR ticket generation, transaction session identification, and SVG iconography | ## Tutorial Run Local & Setup ### 1. **Interactive Search Drawer**: Real-time keyword debounced search modal with live poster suggestions and instant mobile dropdown view. - **Progressive Web App (PWA)**: Standalone mobile installation support with custom web app manifest and cinematic touch icons. --- ## Tech Stack | Category | Technology | Description / Purpose | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **Core Framework** | Next.js `16.1.4` (App Router), React `19.2.3` | Modern server components architecture with fast client navigation | | **Language** | TypeScript `5.0` | Strict type definitions for streaming providers and media metadata | | **Styling** | Vanilla CSS + CSS Modules | Scoped component styling with zero CSS runtime overhead | | **Metadata Source** | TMDB API | Movie posters, episode overviews, release dates, and cast details | | **PWA** | Web App Manifest | Standalone homescreen installation and mobile optimization | --- ## Project Structure ```bash / ├── app/ # Next.js App Router pages and layout routes │ ├── category/ # Dynamic category browsing (/category/[slug]) │ ├── country/ # Regional production catalogs (/country/[code]) │ ├── genre/ # Genre-filtered catalogs (/genre/[id]) │ ├── search/ # Search query results (/search/[query]) │ ├── watch/ # Media playback interface (/watch/movie, /watch/tv) │ └── page.tsx # Homepage with trending hero and featured rows ├── components/ # Reusable UI components, search modal, navbar, and player ├── lib/ # Cloudstream provider scraper (providers.ts), TMDB API, and helpers ├── public/ # Static assets, web app manifest, and icons ├── screenshots/ # Retina mockups for MacBook Pro M4 and iPhone 16 Pro └── README.md ``` --- ## Tutorial Run Local & Setup ### 1. Prerequisites - **Node.js**: Version `20.x` or `22.x` - **npm** or **pnpm** - Database: **No database required** (stateless client player querying public video providers). ### 2. Environment Variables Setup Default TMDB API key telah dibundel secara langsung dalam `lib/requests.ts`, sehingga aplikasi dapat langsung berjalan out-of-the-box tanpa konfigurasi file `.env.local`. ### 3. Installation ```bash # Clone the repository git clone https://github.com/widifirmaan/selikur-cldxtrm-web.git cd selikur-cldxtrm-web # Install dependencies npm install ``` ### 4. Running the Local Server ```bash # Start Next.js development server on port 3001 npx next dev -p 3001 ``` Open [http://localhost:3001](http://localhost:3001) in your browser. ### 5. Production Build ```bash npm run build npm run start ``` --- ## Author Made with ❤️ by **Widi Firmansyah** / [widifirmaan.web.id](https://widifirmaan.web.id)

# Siap Nyafe POS > Fullstack coffee shop point-of-sale, customer self-ordering portal, kitchen display system, and operational management platform built with React 18, Cloudflare Workers, and Cloudflare D1. Siap Nyafe is a full-stack coffee shop management and point-of-sale (POS) web application built with React 18 and a serverless Cloudflare Workers backend powered by Cloudflare D1 SQLite and R2 object storage. Engineered with a bold Neo-Brutalist design system, the platform provides a public customer self-ordering menu, cashier register terminal with instant change calculation, real-time kitchen display system (KDS) order workflows, raw ingredient inventory tracking, staff roster scheduling, equipment asset depreciation logs, and managerial financial accounting. ![Level 30 Scoop of Hope](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/widifirmaan/nextjs-book-games/main/screenshots/Level%2030%20Scoop%20of%20Hope%20Mobile.png) | ## Fitur - **30 Gamified Psychological Activities (`app/level/[id]/page.tsx`)**: Educational reflection exercises divided across 5 Psychological Well-Being (PWB) dimensions: - **Dimension 1: Self Acceptance (Levels 1–7)**: Character word search grid (`Level1WordSearch.tsx`), multi-expression facial sketching (`Level2Drawing.tsx`), hope balloons release (`Level3Games.tsx`), mirror reflection, and self-acceptance box. - **Dimension 2: Environmental Mastery (Levels 8–12)**: Anxiety elixir calming potion mixing (`Level8Games.tsx`), concentric influence circle, freehand drawing canvas (`Level10Drawing.tsx`), relaxing audio sessions, and emotional splash checkpoints. - **Dimension 3: Personal Growth (Levels 13–24)**: Planting wishes on the tree of hope (`Level13Games.tsx`), biggest dream declaration, cloud imagination, sticky notes action planner, and 7 sequential stages of change stairways (`Level18Games.tsx` – `Level24Games.tsx`). - **Dimension 4: Purpose in Life (Levels 25–29)**: Self-exploration questionnaire, three-era time wheel (Past, Present, Future), gratitude treasure map, goal compass, and letter to future self. - **Dimension 5: Positive Relations (Level 30)**: Multi-flavored ice cream scoop of hope (`Level30IceCream.tsx`) capturing wishes for loved ones and social circles. - **Sequential Adventure Progression Map (`app/dashboard/siswa/page.tsx`)**: Student dashboard displaying dynamic level completion counts, prerequisite level locks, and achievement badge milestones. - **Teacher Gradebook & Excel Export (`app/dashboard/guru/page.tsx`)**: Central educator management portal with school and class filtering, student progress tables across all 30 levels with completion status checkmarks, detailed submission response inspection, and 1-click Excel spreadsheet export via SheetJS (`.xlsx`). - **Unified Role-Based Authentication (`app/login/page.tsx`)**: Credentials authentication powered by NextAuth.js separating Teacher (`GURU`) administrative rights from Student (`SISWA`) gameplay sessions. - **Relational SQLite Storage (`schema.sql`)**: Relational database schema persisting student progress, level submission JSON maps, session timestamps, and earned achievement badges in the `users` table. - **HTML5 Canvas Drawing Engine**: Freehand sketch canvas with color palette selection, stroke thickness adjustments, undo history, and base64 data-URL export. --- ## Tech Stack | Category | Technology | Description / Purpose | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **Core Framework** | Next.js `14.2.35` (App Router), React `18.2.0` | Server Components, dynamic level routing, and API Route backend | | **Database** | SQLite 3 / Cloudflare D1 (In-Memory Fallback locally) | Relational database storing user profiles and serialized level records | | **Authentication** | NextAuth.js `4.24.5` | Role-based credential session handling and route protection | | **Spreadsheet Engine** | SheetJS (xlsx) `0.18.5` | Client-side grade report compilation and XLSX binary export | | **Styling** | Tailwind CSS `3.3.0` | Accessible kid-friendly color palettes and responsive grid layouts | | **Type System** | TypeScript `5.0` | Type-safe level components and student submission payloads | ## Tutorial Run Local & Setup ### 1. Prerequisites - **Node.js**: Version `18.17.0` or higher (`20.x` recommended) - **npm** or **pnpm** - Database: **No external database required** (built-in in-memory fallback store for local dev; Cloudflare D1 for edge deployment). ### 2. Environment Variables Setup Create a `.env.local` file in the project root: ```env NEXTAUTH_SECRET=super_secret_local_dev_key_12345 NEXTAUTH_URL=http://localhost:3000 ``` ### 3. Installation ```bash # Clone the repository git clone https://github.com/widifirmaan/nextjs-book-games.git cd nextjs-book-games # Install dependencies npm install ``` ### 4. Database Schema & Seeder Setup Book Games persists user credentials, gameplay progress, and scores in a relational SQLite table (`schema.sql`): ```sql CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users ( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, username TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL, password TEXT NOT NULL, role TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(role IN ('GURU', 'SISWA')), fullName TEXT, email TEXT, kelas TEXT, schoolName TEXT, photoUrl TEXT, level INTEGER DEFAULT 1, levels TEXT DEFAULT '{}', -- JSON map of level completions indukStartTimes TEXT DEFAULT '{}', -- Session start timestamps indukEndTimes TEXT DEFAULT '{}', -- Session finish timestamps dailySubmissions TEXT DEFAULT '{}', -- Daily progress records awards TEXT DEFAULT '[]', -- Earned achievement badge IDs newAwardsToNotify TEXT DEFAULT '[]', -- Pending badge notification queue createdAt TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')), updatedAt TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')) ); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_users_role ON users(role); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_users_username ON users(username); ``` For local development (`npm run dev`), the app automatically provides a built-in in-memory fallback store pre-populated with demo credentials—requiring zero external database configuration. To seed a local Cloudflare D1 database simulation via Wrangler: ```bash # Seed Cloudflare D1 database locally via Wrangler npm run db:seed ``` #### Pre-seeded Demo Accounts & Auth Credentials: - **Teacher Account**: Username `guru` / Password `password` (Access gradebook, analytics, and Excel export) - **Student Account**: Username `siswa` / Password `password` (Access 30-level adventure map and mini-games) ### 5. Running the Local Server ```bash # Start Next.js development server npm run dev ``` Open [http://localhost:3000](http://localhost:3000) in your browser. --- ## Author Made with ❤️ by **Widi Firmansyah** / [widifirmaan.web.id](https://widifirmaan.web.id)

**Evaluation Examination Arena (`quiz.html`, `mulaiquiz.html`)**: 20-question multiple-choice assessment engine featuring client-side JavaScript scoring, answer completion validation, pass/fail threshold calculation (>= 70%), and a Bootstrap 5 result modal. - **OneUI-Inspired Design System (`assets/css/oneui.css`)**: Card-based interface styled with Samsung OneUI-inspired rounded corners (`border-radius: 24px`), pill tab navigation, and mobile bottom navigation controls. - **Audio Narration Player (`index.html`)**: Embedded HTML5 background audio player (`audio.mp3`) on the welcome page to guide new students. - **Academic Bibliography & Team Profile (`daftarpustaka.html`, `profilpengembang.html`)**: Textbook citation modals and academic advisor profiles. --- ## Tech Stack | Category | Technology | Description / Purpose | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **UI Framework** | Bootstrap `5.0.0-beta2` | Responsive layout grid, pill navigation, 16:9 ratio, and modal components | | **Scripting Library** | jQuery `3.3.1` | DOM manipulation and plugin helper script | | **Custom Styling** | OneUI CSS (`assets/css/oneui.css`) | Custom rounded design tokens, floating navbar, and CSS variables | | **Typography** | Poppins Font | Modern sans-serif Google Fonts | | **Iconography** | Font Awesome `5.15.3` | Vector icons for subject categories and navigation buttons | | **Interactivity** | Vanilla JavaScript | Quiz scoring calculation, modal triggering, and answer validation | | **Multimedia** | HTML5 Audio & YouTube Iframe | Homepage audio player and responsive tutorial video player | --- ## Tutorial Run Local & Setup ### 1. Prerequisites - Any modern web browser (Google Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Microsoft Edge). - Python 3 (`python3`) or Node.js (`npx serve`) to serve static HTML files locally. - Database: **No database required** (100% static client-side web template). ### 2. Environment Variables Setup No environment variables are required. ### 3. Installation & Running the Local Server ```bash # 1. Start local static web server # Option A: Using Python 3 python3 -m http.server 8000 # Option B: Using npx serve (if Node.js is installed) npx serve . ``` Open [http://localhost:8000](http://localhost:8000) in your browser. --- ## Author Made with ❤️ by **Widi Firmansyah** / [widifirmaan.web.id](https://widifirmaan.web.id)

**Photo Metadata Editor (`tools/photo-metadata.html`)**: Pure JavaScript binary EXIF parser displaying camera settings, shutter speed, and GPS coordinates with 1-click EXIF stripping for privacy. - **PDF Splitter (`tools/pdf-splitter.html`)**: Page range extraction and visual page thumbnail previews powered by PDF-Lib and Mozilla PDF.js. - **PDF Tools (`tools/pdf-tools.html`)**: Multi-document PDF merger and batch JPG/PNG/WebP images-to-PDF compiler. - **ASCII Art Generator (`tools/ascii-art.html`)**: Image-to-ASCII converter generating monochrome text, styled HTML, and 24-bit ANSI terminal color codes. - **Screen Recorder (`tools/screen-recorder.html`)**: Browser-native DisplayMedia and MediaRecorder screen video capture with microphone audio support and WebM download. - **Instrument Tuner (`tools/audio-tuner.html`)**: Real-time pitch detection via YIN autocorrelation algorithm with -50 to +50 cents deviation needle and live FFT spectrogram. - **Regex Visualizer (`tools/regex-visualizer.html`)**: Regular expression tester with dynamic SVG railroad track flow diagrams and capture group inspection. - **Text Diff (`tools/text-diff.html`)**: Longest Common Subsequence (LCS) text comparator with side-by-side split and unified diff modes. - **QR Code Studio (`tools/qr-code.html`)**: QR code generator for URLs, Wi-Fi, WhatsApp, and vCards, plus webcam and image QR scanner via Html5-QRCode. - **Developer Toolbox (`tools/dev-tools.html`)**: JSON Formatter & Validator, Base64/URL encoder-decoder, and client-side JWT token inspector. - **Text Editor (`tools/text-editor.html`)**: Clean distraction-free text editor with real-time character, word, and reading time counters. - **Barcode Studio (`tools/barcode-studio.html`)**: Pure JavaScript 1D vector barcode generator supporting Code 128, EAN-13, UPC-A, Code 39, and ITF-14. - **Scientific Calculator (`tools/calculator.html`)**: Client-side scientific calculator with trigonometric, logarithmic, and power functions. - **Tire Comparison (`tools/tire-comp.html`)**: Automotive tire specification comparator calculating sidewall height, rolling diameter, ground clearance delta, and speedometer error percentage. - **100% Client-Side Privacy**: All file processing, cryptographic operations, image rendering, and document manipulation execute directly in browser memory—no files or metadata are uploaded to any server. - **Zero Framework Runtime**: Built with Vanilla JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, and CSS3 without external client-side framework overhead. --- ## Tech Stack | Category | Technology | Description / Purpose | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **Core Architecture** | Vanilla JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, CSS3 | Framework-free client-side static web application | | **Cryptography & Privacy** | Web Crypto API (`SubtleCrypto`), AES-GCM, PBKDF2 | Browser-native 256-bit file encryption and key derivation | | **Document Processing** | Mozilla PDF.js `3.11`, PDF-Lib `1.17` | In-browser PDF parsing, previewing, splitting, and merging | | **Audio & Media** | Web Audio API (YIN Autocorrelation), MediaRecorder | Waveform slicing, screen recording, and real-time audio pitch detection | | **On-Device Machine Learning** | `@imgly/background-removal` (WebAssembly) | Neural network background removal running locally in the browser | | **QR Code & Camera** | QRCode.js, Html5-QRCode `2.3` | Client-side QR generation and live webcam video stream decoding | | **Barcode Generators** | Pure JS Barcode Encoders (128, EAN, UPC, 39, ITF) | Vector SVG barcode rendering based on binary pattern specifications | | **UI & Styling** | Bootstrap `5.3`, Bootstrap Icons, AOS | Responsive modern dark interface with off-canvas mobile drawer | --- ## Tutorial Run Local & Setup ### 1. Prerequisites - Any modern web browser (Google Chrome, Mozilla Firefox, Apple Safari, Microsoft Edge). - Python 3 (`python3`) or Node.js (`npx serve`) to serve static HTML files locally. - Database: **No database required** (100% static client-side application). ### 2. # Bash Android AIO Bypass Kit

> Multi-brand Android firmware flashing, Qualcomm EDL firehose loaders, FRP bypass utilities, and platform tools suite.

[![Platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/Platform-Android_ADB_%7C_Fastboot-3DDC84?style=flat-square&logo=android&logoColor=white)](https://developer.android.com/tools/adb)

[![MediaTek](https://img.shields.io/badge/MediaTek-SP_Flash_Tool-F58220?style=flat-square)](https://www.mediatek.com/)
[![Toolkit](https://img.shields.io/badge/Toolkit-Firmware_%26_Binaries-blue?style=flat-square&logo=gnubash&logoColor=white)](#fitur)
[![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-Educational-lightgrey?style=flat-square)](#author)

---

## Platform Target

- **Target Platforms**: Qualcomm Snapdragon (EDL Emergency Download Mode 9008) & MediaTek (BROM / Preloader Mode)
- **Supported Brands**: Xiaomi (76 models), Oppo (49 models), Vivo (24 models), LG (V30 ThinQ), Meizu (22 auth/DA files)
- **Host Environments**: Windows 10/11 (SP Flash Tool & vendor drivers) & Linux / macOS (Native ADB & Fastboot)

---

## Screenshots

| Hardware Testpoint Locator (Vivo Y91 Qualcomm EDL 9008 Pinout) |
| :---: |
| ![Testpoint Guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/widifirmaan/bash-android-aio-bypass-kit/master/Guide/Testpoint%20Vivo%20Y91.png) |

---

## Fitur

- **Qualcomm EDL Emergency Bypass**: Specialized loaders and scripts (`edl.cmd`, `emmcdl.exe`) to interface with devices in Emergency Download mode (Qualcomm HS-USB QDLoader 9008) for partition flashing and unbricking.
- **Extensive Vendor Firmware Hub**: Comprehensive collection of raw vendor firmware, firehose loaders, and partition images for **Xiaomi (76 models)**, **Oppo (49 models)**, **Vivo (24 models)**, and **LG (V30 ThinQ)**.
- **MediaTek Flashing Suite**: Complete scatter files (`sc*.txt`), download agents (`DA_*.bin`), and Meizu authentication keys (`.auth`) for MTK-based smartphones using SP Flash Tool.
- **Factory Reset Protection (FRP) Bypass**: Diagnostic scripts and partition erase scripts targeting FRP and OEM lock configurations on supported Qualcomm and MTK chips.
- **Custom Recovery Repository**: Xiaomi Mi 6 (*sagit*) TWRP recovery image (`Twrp/mi6sagit.img`) ready for fastboot deployment.
- **Platform Tools Integration**: Bundled Windows platform binaries (`adb.exe`, `fastboot.exe`, `emmcdl.exe`) with multi-device status logging (`cekstatus`).

---

## Tech Stack

| Category | Technology | Description / Purpose |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Communication Protocols** | ADB, Fastboot, Qualcomm EDL 9008 | Direct device communication and low-level Emergency Download protocols |
| **Flash Engines** | eMMCDL, SP Flash Tool | Qualcomm raw partition flashing and MediaTek firmware flashing |
| **Scripting Engines** | Bash Shell (.sh), Windows Batch (.cmd) | Automated status checks, EDL mode switching, and flashing batch runners |
| **Firmware Ecosystem** | Xiaomi, Oppo, Vivo, LG, Meizu | Curated brand-specific scatter files, firehose MBNs, and authentication DA files |
| **Custom Recovery** | TWRP (Team Win Recovery Project) | Custom recovery binary for Xiaomi Mi 6 (sagit) |

---

## Project Structure

```bash
/
├── ADB Fastboot eMMCDL/       # Core utilities for ADB, Fastboot, and Qualcomm EDL
│   ├── android/               # Platform-specific binaries (adb.exe, fastboot.exe, emmcdl.exe)
│   ├── Qcom                   # Qualcomm-supported device models reference list
│   └── cekstatus              # Device status log output reference
├── Guide/                     # Hardware testpoint diagrams and reference guides
├── LG/                        # LG device bypass utilities (V30 ThinQ)
├── Meizu/                     # Meizu authentication and init files (22 files)
├── MTK/                       # MediaTek Flashtool, scatter files, and DA agents
├── Oppo/                      # Oppo firmware and bypass files (49 models)
├── Twrp/                      # Custom recovery repository (Xiaomi Mi 6 sagit)
├── Vivo/                      # Vivo firmware and bypass files (24 models)
└── Xiaomi/                    # Xiaomi firmware, EDL loaders, and bypass files (76 models)
```

---

## Tutorial Run Local & Setup

### 1. Prerequisites

- **Operating System**: Windows 10/11 (Recommended for GUI flashing tools and vendor USB drivers) or Linux / macOS.
- **Drivers Required**:
  - Qualcomm HS-USB QDLoader 9008 Driver
  - MediaTek MTK VCOM / Preloader USB Driver
  - Universal ADB / Fastboot Driver

### 2. Device Connection & Verification

```bash
# 1. Clone the repository
git clone https://github.com/widifirmaan/bash-android-aio-bypass-kit.git
cd bash-android-aio-bypass-kit

# 2. Verify connected ADB devices
cd "ADB Fastboot eMMCDL/android"
./adb.exe devices

# 3. Verify connected Fastboot devices
./fastboot.exe devices
```

### 3. Qualcomm EDL Mode Triggering

```cmd
cd "ADB Fastboot eMMCDL"

# Trigger device reboot to Qualcomm EDL 9008 mode
edl.cmd
```

### 4. Troubleshooting Guide

- **Device Not Recognized in ADB**: Enable USB Debugging in Developer Options (tap Build Number 7 times).
- **EDL Port Not Detected (Qualcomm 9008)**: Use hardware testpoint pins (see `Guide/Testpoint Vivo Y91.png`) by shorting testpoints while plugging in the USB cable.
- **SP Flash Tool Authentication Error**: Ensure the appropriate `.auth` and `DA` agent files from `Meizu/` or `MTK/` are selected in SP Flash Tool settings.

- **Full Graphics Acceleration**: Native Intel UHD Graphics 620 acceleration with Metal 2 framework support powered by Lilu and WhateverGreen.
- **Crystal Audio & Jack Sensing**: Realtek ALC256 audio configuration with internal stereo speaker output, combo headset jack sensing, and microphone input via AppleALC and CodecCommander.

## Tutorial Run Local & Setup

### 1. Prerequisites

- **Target Laptop**: ASUS VivoBook Flip TP410UA / TP410UAR.
- **USB Flash Drive**: 8 GB or higher formatted as FAT32 / GUID Partition Map.
- **BIOS Configuration**:
  - Disable **Secure Boot** and **Fast Boot**.
  - Set SATA Controller Mode to **AHCI**.
  - Set DVMT Pre-Allocated to **64MB** (or default if locked).

### 2. EFI Deployment

```bash
# 1. Clone the repository
git clone https://github.com/widifirmaan/clover-asus-vivobookflip-tp410ua.git
cd clover-asus-vivobookflip-tp410ua

# 2. Mount your target EFI partition
# macOS:
sudo diskutil mount /dev/diskXs1

# 3. Copy the repository contents into EFI/CLOVER on your EFI partition
mkdir -p /Volumes/EFI/EFI/CLOVER
cp -R * /Volumes/EFI/EFI/CLOVER/
```

### 3. Compatibility Matrix

| macOS Version | Support Status | Architecture Notes |
| :---: | :---: | :--- |
| **High Sierra (10.13.x)** | ✅ Native Support | Full stability with AptioMemoryFix and native graphics acceleration |
| **Mojave (10.14.x)** | ✅ Native Support | Recommended daily driver release with Metal 2 UHD 620 acceleration |
| **Catalina (10.15.x)** | ✅ Native Support | Fully compatible with 64-bit apps and updated VoodooI2C kexts |
| **Big Sur (11.x) & Newer** | ⚠️ Requires OpenCore | Legacy Clover + AptioMemoryFix lacks runtime support for macOS 11+ kernel |

### 4. Troubleshooting Guide

- **Bootloader Hangs at Startup**: Pass `-v` boot argument in Clover Options to view verbose kernel logs.
- **Audio Output Lost After Sleep**: Reset `coreaudiod` service (`sudo killall coreaudiod`) or verify ALC layout ID in `config.plist`.
- **Trackpad Not Responding**: Ensure `VoodooI2C.kext` and `VoodooI2CHID.kext` are loaded in `kexts/Other/` and I2C controller is enabled in BIOS.

# ECU Database (EcufuncOffline)

> Offline Electronic Control Unit (ECU) database containing BMW ECU functions, service data definitions, and PRG group description files for EDIABAS, EdiabasLib, and Deep OBD diagnostics.

[![Platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/Platform-BMW_OBD_%7C_EDIABAS-0066B1?style=flat-square&logo=bmw&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/widifirmaan/ecu_database)
[![Protocol](https://img.shields.io/badge/Protocol-EdiabasLib_%7C_Deep_OBD-green?style=flat-square)](#fitur-dan-isi-database)
[![Archive](https://img.shields.io/badge/Archive-Split_Binary_Chunks_(~572_MB)-orange?style=flat-square)](#reassembly-dan-ekstraksi)
[![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-Research_%26_Diagnostics-lightgrey?style=flat-square)](#author)

---

## Spesifikasi Database

- **Target Vehicle Ecosystem**: BMW Group Passenger Vehicles (E-Series, F-Series, I-Series, Mini, Rolls-Royce)
- **Compatible Diagnostic Suites**: EDIABAS, INPA, Tool32, EdiabasLib, Deep OBD for Android
- **Archive Structure**: 6 split binary parts (`EcufuncOffline_*.bin`), total raw size ~572 MB (compressed)
- **Extracted Formats**: XML configuration indices (`Content.xml`), ZIP sub-archives (`EcuFunctions.zip`, `ServiceData.zip`), and compiled SGBD binaries (`*.prg`)

---

## Fitur dan Isi Database

- **Complete BMW SGBD Binaries (`EcuBmw/*.prg`)**: Compiled ECU description files defining job commands, memory addresses, real-time sensor parameters, coding indexes, and diagnostic trouble code (DTC) tables.
- **BMW ECU Function Definitions (`Bmw/EcuFunctions.zip`)**: Structured XML function mappings detailing electronic control units across chassis, powertrain, body, and infotainment buses.
- **Service & Maintenance Data (`Bmw/ServiceData.zip`)**: Service reset protocols, adaptation procedures, and actuator test configurations.
- **Master Content Manifest (`Content.xml`)**: Central XML schema indexing ECU versions, checksums, and supported diagnostic interfaces.

---

## Tech Stack & Protokol

| Komponen | Spesifikasi / Format | Keterangan |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **SGBD Runtime** | EDIABAS (Electronic Diagnostic Base System) | Standard BMW internal diagnostic communication layer |
| **ECU Descriptions** | PRG Files (`EcuBmw/*.prg`) | Compiled binary routines for sensor polling, actuator activation, and DTC clearance |
| **Service Mappings** | XML (`Content.xml`, `EcuFunctions.zip`) | Structural taxonomy linking vehicle models to ECU family modules |
| **Client Support** | EdiabasLib & Deep OBD | Native Android / .NET open-source OBD diagnostic interfaces |

---

## Reassembly dan Ekstraksi

Arsip database dipecah menjadi 6 file `EcufuncOffline_*.bin` (maksimal 100 MB per part) untuk mematuhi batas upload Git. Ikuti langkah di bawah ini untuk menggabungkannya kembali menjadi file zip tunggal:

### 1. Linux / Termux / macOS

```bash
# Clone repository
git clone https://github.com/widifirmaan/ecu_database.git
cd ecu_database

# Gabungkan semua part binary
cat EcufuncOffline_*.bin > EcufuncOffline.zip

# Verifikasi integritas arsip ZIP
unzip -t EcufuncOffline.zip

# Ekstrak arsip
unzip EcufuncOffline.zip -d EcufuncOffline/
```

### 2. Windows (Command Prompt)

```cmd
:: Clone repository
git clone https://github.com/widifirmaan/ecu_database.git
cd ecu_database

:: Gabungkan binary chunks via copy binary
copy /b EcufuncOffline_00.bin + EcufuncOffline_01.bin + EcufuncOffline_02.bin + EcufuncOffline_03.bin + EcufuncOffline_04.bin + EcufuncOffline_05.bin EcufuncOffline.zip

:: Ekstrak file zip hasil gabungan menggunakan File Explorer atau 7-Zip
```
